published_sample.sampling_frame: locked v5 memberships reconstructed from assignment family_ids
published_sample.selection: Retain the 24000 lowest seeded hashes per language, enrich them, group by a compound realized stratum, sort strata by size/name, then take one row from each stratum in rounds until 1600.
published_sample.known_defect: The second-stage allocation is deterministic and depends on realized candidate-stratum sizes. stratum_population, stratum_sample_size, inclusion_probability, and sampling_weight were not emitted. Therefore unweighted precision cannot be generalized to the full index.
published_sample.use: challenge and pipeline regression only; not population precision

replacement_design.allocation: Prespecified stratified probability sample with known positive inclusion probability for every in-frame membership; rare-risk oversamples remain in the probability sample only when their inclusion probability is computable.
replacement_design.challenge_set: Separate non-probability file excluded from overall precision.
replacement_design.analysis: Horvitz-Thompson/design-weighted point estimates with stratified family-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals.
